title: Agent runs
description: Claude sessions, Codex process starts and Antigravity traces, activity, turn latency, tokens, errors and host load with linked logs and traces; stored timestamps stay UTC and display uses America/New_York. Namespace filters logs and traces; model filters only signals that carry it. Gaps: agent_account is absent from every Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex turn and token series and some Claude series, so a specific account or host filter hides them (use All); session counters carry no model label; no run or run-name label on any series (run-name column impossible); no harness label (derived from job); codex_exec spans carry no host.name (needs an Alloy resource attribute, a collector follow-up); TPS panels are never red; no run-finished or run-start/stop event (active vs finished is approximate and Claude only); metrics carry no session_id by rule, so the active Claude session panels read Loki, where the namespace and Tool filters apply but host and account do not; no refusal event verified in Loki; cost per run needs a run label; load series exist for host-a, host-b and host-c only; Antigravity run and step boundaries are not verified from span names.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: The service.namespace the agents send. Filters logs and traces.

list.name: service
list.label: Tool
list.description: Agent service; metric jobs may include a namespace prefix.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: Host for metrics, logs and Claude Code traces; Codex traces carry no host.name.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Model for tokens, Codex turns, latency and Claude interactions; start counts without a model remain included.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.description: Account from agent_account metrics and tbhb_account log metadata; traces use tbhb.account.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Session and process start counters, not named runs or completion events.

panels.title: Sessions and process starts in range
panels.description: Claude sessions (fresh or resumed) plus Codex process starts, not distinct named runs or threads; model and namespace do not filter these counters. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (harness) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[$__range]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))

sum by (harness) (label_replace(increase(codex_process_start_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[$__range]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))

panels.title: Runs started per hour by harness
panels.description: Claude sessions (fresh or resumed) plus Codex process starts, not distinct named runs or threads; model and namespace do not filter these counters. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (harness) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))

sum by (harness) (label_replace(increase(codex_process_start_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))

panels.title: Runs started per hour by host
panels.description: Claude sessions (fresh or resumed) plus Codex process starts, not distinct named runs or threads; model and namespace do not filter these counters. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) ((sum by (harness, host_name) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))) or (sum by (harness, host_name) (label_replace(increase(codex_process_start_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))))

panels.title: Runs started per hour by account
panels.description: Claude sessions (fresh or resumed) plus Codex process starts, not distinct named runs or threads; model and namespace do not filter these counters. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_account) ((sum by (harness, agent_account) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))) or (sum by (harness, agent_account) (label_replace(increase(codex_process_start_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))))

panels.title: Runs by model
panels.description: Claude session starts per hour as one series, because session counters carry no model label; Codex counts turns per hour by model, not runs or process starts. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]))

sum by (model) (increase(codex_conversation_turn_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}"}[1h]))

panels.title: Antigravity runs
panels.description: Antigravity traces found by service attribute, not a verified run-start or finish counter; namespace, host, account and model filters do not apply.

panels.title: Antigravity steps
panels.description: Antigravity spans found by service attribute, not a verified step-name or run-boundary classification; namespace, host, account and model filters do not apply.

panels.title: Active and finished
panels.description: Activity proxies only; no run-finished signal is emitted, so finished means sessions seen in range minus active, Claude only, and is approximate.

panels.title: Claude sessions active now
panels.description: Distinct Claude Code session_id values with at least one logged event in five minutes, read from Loki. Metrics carry no session_id by rule. No run-finished signal is emitted; "finished" = sessions seen in range minus active, Claude only, and it is approximate. Only the namespace and Tool filters apply. Claude Code logs carry no host_name or agent_account, and the model filter would hide events that have no model, so those three filters do not apply.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", service_name=~"${service:pipe}", service_namespace=~"${namespace:pipe}"} | session_id=~".+" [5m])))

panels.title: Active Claude sessions
panels.description: Distinct Claude Code session_id values with at least one logged event in five minutes, read from Loki. Metrics carry no session_id by rule. No run-finished signal is emitted; "finished" = sessions seen in range minus active, Claude only, and it is approximate. Only the namespace and Tool filters apply. Claude Code logs carry no host_name or agent_account, and the model filter would hide events that have no model, so those three filters do not apply.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", service_name=~"${service:pipe}", service_namespace=~"${namespace:pipe}"} | session_id=~".+" [5m])))

panels.title: Codex activity (turns per minute)
panels.description: Codex conversation turns per minute, not active sessions: metrics have no session_id; no run-finished signal is emitted; "finished" = sessions seen in range minus active, Claude only, and it is approximate.

targets.expr: sum(rate(codex_conversation_turn_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Duration
panels.description: Turn latency and Claude root interaction durations, not complete run wall time.

panels.title: Codex turn latency p50 and p95
panels.description: End-to-end Codex turn duration at p50 and p95 in milliseconds, not full process or run duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Claude Code interactions
panels.description: Recent traces containing claude_code.interaction spans sorted by durationMs in milliseconds, not full runs; the table shows trace duration, and per-host traces work for Claude Code only because codex_exec spans carry no host.name.

panels.title: Claude Code active time per hour
panels.description: Seconds of Claude active time per hour (user interaction plus CLI work), not elapsed run duration or Codex time. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from some, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum(increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]))

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Token rates by harness and model, not instantaneous generation speed; Codex reports at turn end.

panels.title: Tokens in by model
panels.description: Input tokens per second by harness and model, not generation throughput; Codex includes cached input and reports at turn end. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", type="input"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))

sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", token_type="input"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))

panels.title: Tokens out by model
panels.description: Output tokens per second by harness and model, not live generation throughput; Codex includes reasoning output and reports at turn end. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", type="output"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))

sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", token_type="output"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))

panels.title: Cache tokens by model
panels.description: Claude cacheRead plus cacheCreation and Codex cached_input plus cache_write_input per second, not additional input totals; Codex counts cached input inside input and reports at turn end. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", type=~"cacheRead|cacheCreation"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))

sum by (harness, model) (label_replace(rate(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}", model=~"${model:pipe}", token_type=~"cached_input|cache_write_input"}[$__rate_interval]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))

panels.title: Antigravity tokens by host and model
panels.description: Antigravity input and output tokens per second, summed by host and model (gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum, gen_ai_token_type input and output, probe model delta-probe excluded). The series show 0 until Antigravity runs report. The host and Tool filters apply. There is no account label, so the account and model filters do not apply, and this is not generation speed.

targets.expr: sum by (host_name, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{job=~"(.+/)?(antigravity)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", gen_ai_token_type=~"input|output", gen_ai_request_model!="delta-probe", host_name=~"${host:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors and refusals
panels.description: Verified error events and unsuccessful logs, not refusals; no refusal event is verified in Loki.

panels.title: Agent errors
panels.description: API errors, unsuccessful results and error or warning logs using structured metadata, not refusal events; retained trace_id metadata links through the Loki TraceID derived field.

targets.expr: {service_namespace=~"${namespace:pipe}", service_name=~"claude-code|codex.*"} | service_name=~"${service:pipe}" | host_name=~"${host:pipe}" | tbhb_account=~"${account:pipe}" | event_name="api_error" or success="false" or detected_level=~"error|warn|warning" | label_format detected_level=`{{if or (eq .event_name "api_error") (eq .success "false")}}error{{else}}{{.detected_level}}{{end}}` | line_format `{{.service_name}} {{.event_name}}{{with .host_name}} host_name={{.}}{{end}}{{with .tbhb_account}} tbhb_account={{.}}{{end}}{{with .tool_name}} tool={{.}}{{end}}{{with .status_code}} status={{.}}{{end}}{{with .http_response_status_code}} status={{.}}{{end}}{{with .error_type}} error_type={{.}}{{end}}{{with .trace_id}} trace_id={{.}}{{end}}` | keep service_name, service_namespace, event_name, host_name, tbhb_account, trace_id, tool_name, success, detected_level, status_code, http_response_status_code, error_type

panels.title: Errors per hour
panels.description: API-error events per service normalized to an hourly rate over each interval, not unsuccessful tool results, warnings or refusals.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (count_over_time({service_namespace=~"${namespace:pipe}", service_name=~"claude-code|codex.*"} | service_name=~"${service:pipe}" | host_name=~"${host:pipe}" | tbhb_account=~"${account:pipe}" | event_name="api_error" [$__interval])) * 3600 / ${__interval_s}

panels.title: Host load beside run counts
panels.description: Host-aligned starts and normalized load on separate axes and panels, not a shared-unit comparison.

panels.title: Run starts per hour by host
panels.description: Claude sessions plus Codex process starts by the same selected host, not named runs; Only host-a, host-b and host-c report load; other hosts show runs only; namespace and model do not filter host load or start counts. Account and host filters: agent_account is absent from all Claude and Codex series and host_name from Codex and some Claude series, so choosing one account or host hides them; use All.

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) ((sum by (harness, host_name) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_session_count_total{job=~"(.+/)?(claude-code)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(claude)-code"))) or (sum by (harness, host_name) (label_replace(increase(codex_process_start_total{job=~"(.+/)?(codex.*)", job=~"(.+/)?(${service:pipe})", host_name=~"${host:pipe}", agent_account=~"${account:pipe}"}[1h]), "harness", "$1", "job", "(?:.+/)?(codex).*"))))

panels.title: CPU load per logical core by host
panels.description: One-minute CPU load divided by logical cores for the same selected host, not CPU utilization; Only host-a, host-b and host-c report load; other hosts show runs only; namespace and model do not filter host load or start counts.

targets.expr: system_cpu_load_average_1m{host_name=~"${host:pipe}"} / on(host_name) clamp_min(system_cpu_logical_count{host_name=~"${host:pipe}"}, 1)

panels.title: Logs and traces for a run
panels.description: Recent safe event fields and trace links, not a named-run lookup because no run label exists.

panels.title: Run logs and traces
panels.description: Recent allowlisted log event fields with host_name, tbhb_account and trace_id columns, not named runs; each trace_id opens Tempo through an internal data link.

targets.expr: {service_namespace=~"${namespace:pipe}", service_name=~"claude-code|codex.*"} | service_name=~"${service:pipe}" | host_name=~"${host:pipe}" | tbhb_account=~"${account:pipe}" | line_format `{"service_name":{{printf "%q" .service_name}},"service_namespace":{{printf "%q" .service_namespace}},"event_name":{{printf "%q" .event_name}},"host_name":{{printf "%q" .host_name}},"tbhb_account":{{printf "%q" .tbhb_account}},"trace_id":{{printf "%q" .trace_id}},"tool_name":{{printf "%q" .tool_name}},"success":{{printf "%q" .success}},"duration_ms":{{printf "%q" .duration_ms}}}` | keep service_name, service_namespace, event_name, host_name, tbhb_account, trace_id, tool_name, success, duration_ms
